title: Book One · Chapter 126: The Wrong Corner
story:
Leo draws a map of River Street in blue pencil. He makes the road very straight. But the real road bends near the food shop.

“A straight road is easier,” he says.

“Not if you walk on it,” Ronan says.

Miss Wu says they may make a small map. It can go on the wall. Mei will look at the finished map. She has agreed to that. She will not draw it all for them. She has her own picture to finish.

Ronan marks the green gate with a square. Leo draws Mr Qiu's old stall. The two places seem much closer together on paper.

“We need the turn,” Ronan says.

“We have the arrow.”

“The arrow goes through a wall.”

Leo looks. Ronan is right. He rubs out that part of the blue road. A grey mark is left on the paper.

After school Mum walks with them. They carry the map on a board. At each corner Ronan stops and points. Leo puts a little mark on the paper.

The first turn is easy. The second is behind a wide doorway. On their map the turn leads into the doorway. Someone might go inside by mistake.

“Could someone go in there?” Mum asks.

“They would see the wall,” Leo says.

“Yes. But first they would go into the wrong doorway.”

Ronan remembers a different map, when he was smaller. That map led someone the wrong way. He does not want this map to do that. He makes the turn larger.

At the green gate, Mrs Lan looks at the paper.

“You have put my front room in the road.”

Leo bends over it. “Only a little.”

“I would rather keep all of it here.”

She points to the gate. “The table stands here,” she says. Ronan draws a small line for the wall. Behind it he leaves the yard empty.

“Can we put our room?” he asks Mum.

“This map shows the way to the table. Does it need our room?”

He shakes his head and puts the pencil away.

Mr Qiu studies the map next. He turns it towards the street. A woman stops to look over his shoulder.

“Is there a new road?” she asks.

“Not yet,” Leo says. “We are still making this one.”

She laughs. Then she points to the blue bend.

“That looks like a river.”

The boys look at each other. River Street has become a river on their map.

At home Leo wants to begin again. Ronan wants to change the colour. They sit with the paper between them until Mum puts a cup beside each boy.

“Where do I start? Please show me,” she says.

Ronan puts his finger on the old stall. Leo moves the blue pencil along the route. Together they add the words START HERE. Then they draw two plain arrows and the green gate.

They ask Mrs Lan to try it too. She sits on the other side of the table. From there, the map is upside down. Leo begins to turn it for her.

“Wait,” Ronan says. “People may hold it this way.”

They draw the river near the edge of the paper. Now Mrs Lan can find the river. She can read the map from this side. She finds the food shop, then the turn. Her finger stops at her own gate.

“Home,” she says.

Leo rubs his nose with the blue pencil by mistake. There is a new mark on him too.

Mum follows the arrows with one finger. She arrives at the right place.

“Tea,” she says, and pushes their cups nearer.

Leo signs his name at the bottom. Ronan signs beside it. Neither name is in the road.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：bend＝转弯处；route＝路线；start here＝从这里出发。

情节提示：upside down＝倒过来的；square＝方形；by mistake＝不小心、无意中。

理解：1. 地图最初会把人引向哪里？2. 两个男孩最后加了什么帮助读图？
